name: 90706 · Bellflower, CA
findings: ZIP 90706 (Bellflower) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90706 (Bellflower) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90706 (Bellflower) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
